verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs state that notes can always be exported into an open format such as HTML or Markdown, which covers the core of the story: an archive that does not depend on the vendor. The support rests on a single line, though, with no detail on export structure. Separate reflect.app claims of open-source local Markdown files conflict with the end-to-end-encrypted cloud model documented elsewhere, so they were not relied on. Missing for 10: JSON or structured export, documentation of export fidelity (backlinks, attachments, metadata), hands-on or independent corroboration of the export.
